correctness.rationale: A full ordered-bigram count vector c_ij of a word length m+1 is exactly an integer 3×3 arc-count matrix admitting an Eulerian directed trail. The standard necessary-and-sufficient criterion is weak connectivity on all positive-degree vertices and degree imbalance either (0,0,0) or permutation (+1,-1,0). In balanced class write δ01=δ12=δ20=t; t≠0 forces directed triangle, t=0 splits by one/2/3 occupied vertices with loops and bidirected edges. In each unbalanced ordered start/end type δ01=t+1, δ12=δ20=t; all entries parameterized by opposite arc pairs and loops, subtract the precise t=0 disconnected third-vertex loop class. Combining balanced A(z) and six(F(z)-B(z)) gives z(9−12z+5z²+19z³−4z⁴−10z⁵−14z⁶+14z⁷+6z⁸−9z⁹+3z¹⁰)/((1−z)^7(1+z)^2(1+z+z²)). Independently simplified expressions in SymPy to identical rational fraction and checked coefficients 9,24,65,... for small m. Dominant pole z=1 order seven with numerator 7 and cofactor 12 gives 7m^6/8640+O(m^5), period divides six. m≥1; length-one host has a single empty profile separately. Code-size follows by one representative per profile.

originality.rationale: Qualified PASS: Euler trail criterion, generic reconstruction algorithms, and binary exact two-gram multispectrum are prior. Bernardini–Conte–Gabory and collaborators study equality of *sets* of factors, not the *multiplicity* count vector; changing sets to multisets changes equivalence classes. The new exact all-m ternary integral Euler-flow count and degree-six quasipolynomial are not implied by those published statements, though an older enumeration of 3×3 integer Euler trails could subsume it.
residual_risks: Classical integer Eulerian flow matrix generating functions or multivariate walk enumerators could yield the same rational series.
